raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
This PR is part of a merged stack (oldest at bottom):

* __->__ #46330 (merged)
* #46290 (merged)

## Motivation

CUDA currently rejects DFLASH with attention DP. Enable plain DFlash and selector-based DFlash2 using the draft placement resolved by #46290, including unequal local batches and idle DP replicas.

## Modifications

- Admit CUDA attention DP with explicit `--enable-dp-lm-head`, CP=1 and PP=1. Reject Domino/LiLiCorr heads and the unimplemented experimental heterogeneous prefill/verify coordination mode.
- Reconstruct the embedding actually used by the draft on that embedding's own TP group before serving. Preserve padded/added vocabulary ordering, embedding quantization methods and output dtype.
- Defer DFLASH DP target-verify attention planning and graph-buffer loading to the runner, after final batch preparation and graph eligibility decisions. Stop marking deferred metadata ready through the deprecated `skip_attn_backend_init` argument.
- Initialize empty mRoPE positions for idle batches so DP padding can materialize valid target-verify rows.
- Read target DP state before entering the narrowed draft scope. Keep the draft eager under DP, retain eligible target CUDA graphs, and warm selector kernels during startup.
- Add focused unit tests, two registered four-GPU nightly E2E cases, and launch documentation.

The skip-argument changes are confined to DFLASH callers; EAGLE/NextN metadata decisions and the shared runner are unchanged. Empty idle mRoPE initialization is a shared `ForwardBatch` change and also applies to other algorithms using mRoPE models. Non-DP/DSpark preplanning defaults and NPU-specific behavior are preserved.

## Accuracy Tests

Current head: `3a19e047cd4005fab35678d800a7d790f5bafd30`, rebased onto main `6623ea445a287ff89fa61165a9d129daeee4ac34` after #46290 merged. Tests were not rerun for this landing rebase; the results below retain their original revision attribution. The parent now fixes the CPU source-audit failure by using sequence-checked DP slot reads in its draft-scope test. The DFLASH feature patch is unchanged by restacking.

**Follow-up validation at `f50467b918d3849db781dd5cd98e98fec4b96b9c`: 180 CPU tests passed** across the complete `test_draft_tp_context.py` (11) and `test_runtime_context.py` (169), including the previously failing full-checkout raw-slot scan. Changed-file pre-commit and whitespace checks passed. Only the inherited test changed from the previous stack head; production code and the architecture allowlist are unchanged. The original feature results below retain their original commit attribution; GPU tests were not repeated for this test-only fix.

Tested commit `f31e240a083d25a5e6d21b5ea50f7f7be11c3bb8`, based on #46290 at `42a50ed474230f2dc85652539307bbc304dd0dbd`.

**CPU: 100 passed, 1 skipped.** Includes 9 new admission/embedding/metadata cases and 91 existing DFLASH, metadata-plan and fused-placement checks. The skipped Triton test requires CUDA. Changed-file pre-commit checks passed.

**GPU: 4 × NVIDIA H200, TP4 / attention DP2.** Deterministic FA3 target with FlashInfer draft, compared against target-only at the same TP/DP layout:

| Target / draft | Greedy token IDs compared | Result |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `Qwen/Qwen3-4B` / `z-lab/Qwen3-4B-DFlash-b16` | 320 | Exact match |
| `Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B` / `incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2` | 320 | Exact match |

Each fixture also passed a 64-token sampled smoke. Cases cover individual DP replicas, idle peers, concurrent unequal lengths and prefix reuse, with target CUDA graphs enabled. Additional FlashInfer target/draft eager and graph runs completed for both families; actual target graph execution was observed. A non-DP TP4 DFLASH graph smoke also completed.

Run the registered regressions with:

```bash
python test/registered/unit/spec/test_dflash_dp_attention.py
python test/registered/e2e/speculative/test_dflash_dp_attention.py
```

Environment: driver 595.71.05, Torch 2.14.1+cu130, FlashInfer 0.7.2, sglang-kernel 0.4.10, DeepEP 0.1.2.post1, DeepGEMM 0.2.3.post2 and Transformers 5.19.0.

Limits: exact parity is established for the deterministic, same-layout comparisons above; default FlashInfer target-only output itself varied with batch shape. This feature commit has no dedicated DP + EAGLE/MTP GPU regression. NPU, CP, PP, MoE transports, quantized embedding checkpoints, LoRA and multimodal inputs were not qualified on device. Documentation build checks were not run.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No performance benchmark was run; no speedup claim.

## Checklist

- [x] Changed-file pre-commit checks pass.
- [x] Add and run focused unit and GPU tests.
- [x] Document supported layouts and launch flags.
- [x] Report accuracy results and validation limits.
- [x] Follow SGLang code style.

files.patch: @@ -101,7 +101,7 @@ SGLang provides several speculative decoding options, including EAGLE-2/EAGLE-3, DFlash draft model (linear block verification) Yes --speculative-algorithm DFLASH + --speculative-draft-model-path ... - No DP attention (--attn-dp-size > 1); pp_size == 1; disables overlap scheduler & mixed chunked prefill + CUDA DP attention requires --enable-dp-lm-head and attn_cp_size == 1; pp_size == 1 STANDALONE @@ -620,6 +620,37 @@ response = client.chat.completions.create( print(response.choices[0].message.content) ``` +### DFlash and DFlash2 with DP attention + +On NVIDIA CUDA, you can use attention DP with plain DFlash drafts and DFlash2 +candidate-selector checkpoints. Both use `--speculative-algorithm DFLASH`. +Set `--enable-dp-lm-head` so the target head has the same vocabulary shards as +its local draft replica. Pipeline parallelism and DP combined with context +parallelism are not supported. Domino and LiLiCorr heads are not supported +with CUDA DP attention. + +For example, on four NVIDIA GPUs, use TP4 with attention DP2 / TP2: + +```bash Command +python3 -m sglang.launch_server \ + --model-path Qwen/Qwen3-4B \ + --speculative-algorithm DFLASH \ + --speculative-draft-model-path z-lab/Qwen3-4B-DFlash-b16 \ + --tp-size 4 \ + --attn-dp-size 2 \ + --enable-dp-lm-head \ + --attention-backend flashinfer \ + --speculative-draft-attention-backend flashinfer \ + --cuda-graph-backend-prefill disabled +``` + +For DFlash2, use a matching target and selector checkpoint, such as +`Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B` and `incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2`. +Each attention-DP group runs its draft within the local attention-TP group. +Draft execution stays eager; eligible target verify batches can use CUDA graphs. +The scheduler separates prefill and verify rounds across DP ranks. Keep the +experimental `SGLANG_ENABLE_DP_SPEC_PREFILL_COORDINATION` setting disabled. + ### LiLiCorr: reranked DFlash drafts A DFlash drafter is trained on per-position marginals rather than on the joint block distribution, so its drafted tokens are individually plausible yet jointly incoherent. **LiLiCorr** ([arXiv:2608.20530](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.20530)) keeps the top-`k` candidates per block position, scores the whole lattice jointly with a small two-layer transformer, and commits a path through it greedily instead of taking the per-slot argmax. Verify is unchanged, so outputs remain distributionally identical to the target model's and only acceptance length moves.

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.unquant import UnquantizedEmbeddingMethod
+from sglang.srt.layers.vocab_parallel_embedding import VocabParallelEmbedding
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def gather_draft_embedding(embedding: nn.Module) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+    # Other modules may scale their output or own a checkpoint embedding.
+    if not isinstance(embedding, VocabParallelEmbedding):
+        return None
+    if isinstance(embedding.quant_method, UnquantizedEmbeddingMethod):
+        weight = embedding.weight
+    else:
+        # Packed weights are not embedding rows. Materialize the table through
+        # the same quantization method as an ordinary embedding lookup.
+        ids = torch.arange(
+            embedding.num_embeddings_per_partition,
+            device=next(embedding.parameters()).device,
+        )
+        weight = embedding.quant_method.embedding(embedding, ids)
+    if embedding.output_dtype is not None:
+        weight = weight.to(embedding.output_dtype)
+    if embedding.tp_size == 1 and embedding.num_embeddings == embedding.org_vocab_size:
+        return weight[: embedding.num_embeddings]
+
+    shards = (
+        embedding.tp_group.all_gather(weight, dim=0).view(
+            embedding.tp_size, *weight.shape
+        )
+        if embedding.tp_size > 1
+        else weight.unsqueeze(0)
+    )
+    full_weight = weight.new_empty((embedding.num_embeddings, weight.shape[1]))
+    for rank, shard in enumerate(shards):
+        indices = embedding._get_indices(
+            embedding.num_embeddings_padded,
+            embedding.org_vocab_size_padded,
+            embedding.num_embeddings,
+            embedding.org_vocab_size,
+            rank,
+            embedding.tp_size,
+        )
+        full_weight[indices.org_vocab_start_index : indices.org_vocab_end_index].copy_(
+            shard[: indices.num_org_elements]
+        )
+        offset = indices.num_org_elements_padded
+        full_weight[
+            indices.added_vocab_start_index : indices.added_vocab_end_index
+        ].copy_(shard[offset : offset + indices.num_added_elements])
+    return full_weight

+"""DFLASH DP replicas must preserve target outputs with sharded vocabulary tables."""
+
+import unittest
+from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+
+import requests
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import (
+    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+    DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST,
+    CustomTestCase,
+    popen_launch_server,
+    terminate_and_kill_process_tree,
+)
+
+# TP4 / DP2 exercises both local attention TP and idle attention-DP peers.
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=480, stage="nightly", runner_config="4-gpu-h100")
+
+
+class TestDFlashDPAttention(CustomTestCase):
+    @contextmanager
+    def _server(self, model, revision, draft=None, draft_revision=None):
+        args = [
+            "--revision",
+            revision,
+            "--tp-size",
+            "4",
+            "--attn-dp-size",
+            "2",
+            "--enable-dp-lm-head",
+            "--attention-backend",
+            "fa3",
+            "--enable-deterministic-inference",
+            "--mem-fraction-static",
+            "0.6",
+            "--context-length",
+            "4096",
+            "--max-total-tokens",
+            "16384",
+            "--max-running-requests",
+            "8",
+            "--chunked-prefill-size",
+            "1024",
+            "--cuda-graph-backend-prefill",
+            "disabled",
+            "--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode",
+            "4",
+            "--random-seed",
+            "42",
+        ]
+        if draft is not None:
+            args += [
+                "--speculative-algorithm",
+                "DFLASH",
+                "--speculative-draft-model-path",
+                draft,
+                "--speculative-draft-model-revision",
+                draft_revision,
+                "--speculative-draft-attention-backend",
+                "flashinfer",
+            ]
+        process = popen_launch_server(
+            model,
+            DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST,
+            timeout=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+            other_args=args,
+            env={"SGLANG_ENABLE_STRICT_MEM_CHECK_DURING_BUSY": "1"},
+        )
+        try:
+            yield
+        finally:
+            terminate_and_kill_process_tree(process)
+
+    def _generate(self, prompt, rank, length, temperature=0):
+        response = requests.post(
+            DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST + "/generate",
+            json={
+                "text": prompt,
+                "routed_dp_rank": rank,
+                "sampling_params": {
+                    "temperature": temperature,
+                    "max_new_tokens": length,
+                    "ignore_eos": True,
+                    "sampling_seed": 42,
+                },
+            },
+            timeout=180,
+        )
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        result = response.json()
+        self.assertEqual(len(result["output_ids"]), length)
+        return result
+
+    def _check_model(self, model, revision, draft, draft_revision):
+        prompts = [
+            ("The capital of France is", 16),
+            (
+                "Explain how a compiler translates source code into machine instructions. "
+                * 12,
+                64,
+            ),
+        ]
+        with self._server(model, revision):
+            reference = [
+                self._generate(text, 0, n)["output_ids"] for text, n in prompts
+            ]
+        with self._server(model, revision, draft, draft_revision):
+            # Isolated requests exercise idle peers, in both rank directions.
+            for rank in (0, 1):
+                for (text, n), expected in zip(prompts, reference):
+                    result = self._generate(text, rank, n)
+                    self.assertEqual(result["output_ids"], expected)
+                    self.assertGreater(result["meta_info"]["spec_verify_ct"], 0)
+            # Unequal lengths transition between active and idle peers, with
+            # target graphs enabled and cached prefixes on both replicas.
+            for rank in (0, 1):
+                with ThreadPoolExecutor(2) as pool:
+                    futures = [
+                        pool.submit(self._generate, text, (rank + i) % 2, n)
+                        for i, (text, n) in enumerate(prompts)
+                    ]
+                    for future, expected in zip(futures, reference):
+                        self.assertEqual(future.result()["output_ids"], expected)
+            sampled = self._generate(
+                "Write a short story about an astronomer.", 1, 64, 0.7
+            )
+            self.assertGreater(sampled["meta_info"]["spec_verify_ct"], 0)
+
+    def test_dflash(self):
+        self._check_model(
+            "Qwen/Qwen3-4B",
+            "1cfa9a7208912126459214e8b04321603b3df60c",
+            "z-lab/Qwen3-4B-DFlash-b16",
+            "b74e3a329c4d963783143b1e970d95b002be72bd",
+        )
+
+    def test_dflash2_hybrid_target(self):
+        self._check_model(
+            "Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B",
+            "1d4bf0f2ff6012fd82039f2fa52739d0dd7c60c0",
+            "incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2",
+            "015e795645c74b1a0eeef3b570031fb62e769bc5",
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from sglang.srt.arg_groups.overrides import resolution_result
+from sglang.srt.arg_groups.speculative_hook import _handle_dflash
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.layers import linear, vocab_parallel_embedding
+from sglang.srt.layers.vocab_parallel_embedding import VocabParallelEmbedding
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardBatch, ForwardMode
+from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs
+from sglang.srt.speculative import dflash_info
+from sglang.srt.speculative.dflash_dp import gather_draft_embedding
+from sglang.srt.speculative.dflash_info import DFlashVerifyInput
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=8, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestDFlashDPAdmission(CustomTestCase):
+    def _args(self, **overrides):
+        fields = dict(
+            model_path="dummy",
+            device="cuda",
+            tp_size=4,
+            attn_dp_size=2,
+            attn_cp_size=1,
+            enable_dp_lm_head=True,
+            speculative_algorithm="DFLASH",
+            speculative_draft_model_path="draft",
+            speculative_num_draft_tokens=8,
+            speculative_draft_attention_backend="flashinfer",
+        )
+        return ServerArgs(**(fields | overrides))
+
+    def test_cuda_dp_keeps_explicit_placement_and_raw_input(self):
+        args = self._args()
+        _handle_dflash(args)
+        self.assertTrue(args.enable_dp_lm_head)
+        self.assertEqual(resolution_result(args, "attn_dp_size"), 2)
+        self.assertIsNone(args.speculative_num_steps)
+        self.assertEqual(resolution_result(args, "speculative_num_steps"), 1)
+
+    def test_incompatible_cuda_dp_layouts_fail(self):
+        for fields, message in [
+            ({"enable_dp_lm_head": False}, "enable-dp-lm-head"),
+            ({"attn_cp_size": 2}, "context parallel"),
+            ({"pp_size": 2}, "pp_size"),
+            ({"device": "xpu"}, "CUDA or NPU"),
+        ]:
+            with (
+                self.subTest(fields=fields),
+                self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, message),
+            ):
+                _handle_dflash(self._args(**fields))
+
+    def test_unimplemented_mixed_prefill_coordination_fails_at_startup(self):
+        with (
+            envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_DP_SPEC_PREFILL_COORDINATION.override(True),
+            self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "DP_SPEC_PREFILL_COORDINATION=0"),
+        ):
+            _handle_dflash(self._args())
+
+    def test_non_dp_does_not_require_dp_head(self):
+        args = self._args(attn_dp_size=1, enable_dp_lm_head=False)
+        _handle_dflash(args)
+        self.assertFalse(resolution_result(args, "enable_dp_lm_head"))
+
+
+class _TableGroup:
+    def __init__(self, shards):
+        self.shards = shards
+
+    def all_gather(self, weight, dim):
+        if not any(torch.equal(weight, shard) for shard in self.shards):
+            raise AssertionError("embedding used a different table's group")
+        return torch.cat(self.shards, dim=dim)
+
+
+def _embedding_shards(org_vocab, added_vocab, tp_size):
+    embeddings = []
+    for rank in range(tp_size):
+        parallel = SimpleNamespace(tp_size=tp_size, tp_rank=rank, tp_group=None)
+        with (
+            patch.object(
+                vocab_parallel_embedding, "get_parallel", return_value=parallel
+            ),
+            patch.object(linear, "get_parallel", return_value=parallel),
+        ):
+            embedding = VocabParallelEmbedding(
+                num_embeddings=org_vocab + added_vocab,
+                org_num_embeddings=org_vocab,
+                embedding_dim=2,
+                padding_size=8,
+            )
+        indices = embedding.shard_indices
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            embedding.weight.fill_(-999)
+            for token in range(
+                indices.org_vocab_start_index, indices.org_vocab_end_index
+            ):
+                embedding.weight[token - indices.org_vocab_start_index].fill_(token)
+            for token in range(
+                indices.added_vocab_start_index, indices.added_vocab_end_index
+            ):
+                offset = (
+                    indices.num_org_elements_padded
+                    + token
+                    - indices.added_vocab_start_index
+                )
+                embedding.weight[offset].fill_(token)
+        embeddings.append(embedding)
+    group = _TableGroup([embedding.weight for embedding in embeddings])
+    for embedding in embeddings:
+        embedding.tp_group = group
+    return embeddings
+
+
+class TestDFlashDPEmbedding(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_padding_and_added_vocabulary_keep_logical_token_ids(self):
+        """Uneven and empty vocabulary shards must not shift token IDs after gathering."""
+        for org_vocab, added_vocab, tp_size in [(5, 0, 4), (9, 3, 4), (9, 3, 1)]:
+            with self.subTest(
+                org_vocab=org_vocab, added_vocab=added_vocab, tp_size=tp_size
+            ):
+                expected = (
+                    torch.arange(org_vocab + added_vocab)
+                    .float()
+                    .unsqueeze(1)
+                    .expand(-1, 2)
+                )
+                for embedding in _embedding_shards(org_vocab, added_vocab, tp_size):
+                    # The table's retained group wins over any ambient draft/target scope.
+                    actual = gather_draft_embedding(embedding)
+                    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected)
+
+    def test_replicated_table_keeps_storage(self):
+        embedding = _embedding_shards(9, 0, 1)[0]
+        actual = gather_draft_embedding(embedding)
+        self.assertEqual(actual.data_ptr(), embedding.weight.data_ptr())
+        torch.testing.assert_close(actual[:, 0], torch.arange(9).float())
+
+    def test_materialized_embedding_preserves_quant_method_and_output_dtype(self):
+        embeddings = _embedding_shards(9, 3, 4)
+        group = _TableGroup([e.weight.double() * 2 for e in embeddings])
+        for embedding in embeddings:
+            embedding.quant_method = SimpleNamespace(
+                embedding=lambda layer, ids: layer.weight[ids].double() * 2
+            )
+            embedding.output_dtype = torch.float64
+            embedding.tp_group = group
+            actual = gather_draft_embedding(embedding)
+            expected = (torch.arange(12).double() * 2).unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, 2)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected)
+
+    def test_other_embedding_keeps_its_forward_semantics(self):
+        class ScaledEmbedding(nn.Embedding):
+            def forward(self, ids):
+                return super().forward(ids) * 2
+
+        embedding = ScaledEmbedding(8, 2)
+        self.assertIsNone(gather_draft_embedding(embedding))
+
+
+class TestDFlashDPMetadata(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_deferred_verify_preserves_live_inputs_until_final_planning(self):
+        """Early graph loading must not replace an idle or unequal DP batch's live rows."""
+        for mode in (ForwardMode.IDLE, ForwardMode.DECODE):
+            for graph_eligible in (False, True):
+                with self.subTest(mode=mode, graph_eligible=graph_eligible):
+                    n = 0 if mode.is_idle() else 4
+                    ids = torch.arange(n)
+                    forward = ForwardBatch(
+                        forward_mode=mode,
+                        batch_size=0 if mode.is_idle() else 1,
+                        input_ids=ids,
+                        req_pool_indices=torch.zeros(
+                            0 if mode.is_idle() else 1, dtype=torch.long
+                        ),
+                        seq_lens=torch.ones(
+                            0 if mode.is_idle() else 1, dtype=torch.long
+                        ),
+                        out_cache_loc=ids,
+                        seq_lens_sum=0 if mode.is_idle() else 1,
+                        positions=ids,
+                    )
+
+                    def preplan(batch):
+                        batch.input_ids = torch.full((8,), -1)
+                        batch.mark_forward_metadata_ready()
+
+                    runner = SimpleNamespace(
+                        decode_cuda_graph_runner=SimpleNamespace(
+                            can_run_graph=lambda batch: graph_eligible,
+                            load_batch=preplan,
+                        ),
+                        attn_backend=SimpleNamespace(init_forward_metadata=preplan),
+                    )
+                    batch = SimpleNamespace(forward_mode=mode)
+                    spec = DFlashVerifyInput(
+                        draft_token=ids, positions=ids, draft_token_num=4
+                    )
+                    with (
+                        patch.object(dflash_info, "_is_npu", False),
+                        patch.object(ForwardBatch, "init_new", return_value=forward),
+                        patch(
+                            "sglang.srt.speculative.spec_utils.prepare_mamba_track_for_verify"
+                        ),
+                    ):
+                        result, can_graph = spec.prepare_for_verify(
+                            batch,
+                            SimpleNamespace(model_runner=runner),
+                            defer_metadata_init=True,
+                        )
+                    torch.testing.assert_close(result.input_ids, ids)
+                    self.assertTrue(result.needs_forward_metadata_init())
+                    self.assertEqual(can_graph, graph_eligible)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
